page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.se1.xlarge delivers modest processing and memory throughput. In stress-ng testing, single-core CPU performance scored 1100.49 and multi-core performance reached 2931.93, both placing in the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth tests showed 163.82 GB/sec for cached small blocks, but dropped to 20.19 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, which is categorized in the bottom 10%. Similarly, Geekbench scores reflect lower-tier performance, with a single-core score of 918.0 and a multi-core score of 1990.0.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio combined with lower-tier compute and memory bandwidth performance, this instance is best suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency processing. Appropriate use cases include caching layers, lightweight database operations, and memory-bound applications with low CPU utilization. The lack of local storage requires attaching external block storage, and the 1 Gbps network baseline limits its suitability for high-throughput network tasks.
